verdict.rationale: Productboard's built-in agent, Spark, consumes at least one external MCP server: it can query Notion live through "Spark's MCP connector" (intdir-5). It also offers natural-language connectors for Amplitude, Linear and Slack (intdir-6/7/8), though those are not labeled MCP. This looks like a curated set of first-party connectors, not the ability for users to plug in arbitrary MCP servers. The extensive MCP-server docs are server-side and were not credited. Missing for 10: evidence users can add their own or arbitrary MCP servers, client-side MCP configuration docs, a confirmed MCP transport for the other connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
